text:
Maya P: AM async — quick pulse for the sprint (what I did / blockers / today)
- Did: finished routing spec draft (link: https://redwood.internal/specs/routing-v2) and pushed PR #3421 for the server-side routing table change.
- Blocker: flaky e2e failing on head; need infra help to repro on dedicated pool.
- Today: will iterate on PR feedback, draft release note and customer comms. Asking @Tom H and @Devon R for reviews; @Sasha L can you confirm canary window availability?

Tom H: Got it — will review PR #3421 today. Quick question: does this touch any SDK header shapes or is it fully server-side? :question:

Maya P: No SDK header changes, just server routing table logic. I'll add a changelog note to be safe.

Devon R: Review incoming, aiming for EOD. FYI I saw a perf regression locally when batching at 16 — might be related to the quantized kernel selector. I'll add notes to the PR.

Sasha L: Canary window looks okay — I can do a 16:30 PT slot for a 2h run. infra capacity seems fine but want to reserve a dedicated slot. @deploy-bot can you reserve pool?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reserved canary slot on pool-dedicated-2 for 16:30-18:30 PT. Canary job template: `./deploy/canary.sh --pool pool-dedicated-2 --model rwd-v2-lite --roll 1`

Maya P: Thanks — Devon, can you paste the perf repro steps here? if it's quantization-related we should have a rollback plan ready.

Devon R: Repro steps: `python tools/bench.py --model rwd-v2-lite --batch 16 --seq 1024` — repros in ~2 runs. Logs show `OOM approx at kernel_launch`. Suspect kernel selector picks an fp16 path that's unstable; testing forcing int8 quant now.

Tom H: If int8 fixes perf, prefer that for the canary. Also tagging @Sasha L — do we have auto-fallback configured in Console for this rollout?

Sasha L: Yes — rollout policy v3 has auto-fallback to `rwd-v2-standard` when p99 latency > 1200ms for 5m. I'll re-verify thresholds and add a runbook note.

Maya P: Action items:
- Tom H: review PR #3421 (owner)
- Devon R: triage perf, open fix PR if needed (owner)
- Sasha L: finalize canary reservation + confirm fallback (owner)
I'll draft the release note and schedule customer comms once PR is green. Everyone please ack here so I can mark owners in the plan.

Tom H: :thumbsup: ack — will review by 3pm PT.

Devon R: :rocket: will open fix PR this morning if int8 helps.

Sasha L: :white_check_mark: canary reserved and fallback verified.
